title: Popice: a brand made to melt hearts.
alt: Popice ice-lolly packaging and product identity in vivid pink
description: A playful identity for Popice, built across packaging, patterns, campaign graphics and digital formats.
storyTitle: Bright, familiar and ready for summer.
story: A rounded wordmark, repeating ice-lolly pattern and unapologetic pink palette give Popice a distinct visual voice. The system stays recognisable from packaging to banners and social posts.

title: Crochetique: crafted into a complete identity.
alt: Crochetique outdoor campaign mockup for a handmade crochet brand
description: A complete identity for Crochetique, connecting its woven mark with packaging, editorial, outdoor and digital applications.
storyTitle: A handmade idea, built to travel.
story: The identity starts with an interlocking woven mark and a calm blue palette. From there, it expands into packaging, print, campaigns and web layouts without losing the warmth of the craft.

title: Chennai Apparel Association: fashion in motion.
alt: Chennai Apparel Association garment fair campaign poster
description: A broad campaign system for Chennai Apparel Association, spanning social media, venue graphics and trade-fair communication.
storyTitle: One event, many points of contact.
story: A high-contrast yellow and navy system keeps the fair recognisable across fashion-led social posts, stage graphics, welcome boards and large-format venue pieces.

title: From screen to celebration.
alt: The entrance to Toca Boca kids carnival with colourful event signage and graphics by Desira
description: Event graphics for the Toca Boca kids carnival in Chennai, taking Desira’s designs from the screen into a lively real-world celebration.
story: The visual system moved across entrances, directional signs, food stalls, pillars and sponsor displays. Each piece helped turn a large venue into one connected carnival world.

title: Shah & Shah Steels: clear information, built to last.
alt: Shah and Shah Steels corporate catalog cover
description: A structured catalog and stationery set that makes a technical product range easier to understand and navigate.
story: A restrained blue-and-white system gives product photography, specifications and company information a consistent hierarchy across the catalog, business card, envelope and letterhead.

title: Avira Udaan: a campaign across the whole event.
alt: Avira Udaan exhibition invitation with illustrated market stalls
description: Invitations, guest announcements, sponsor communication and stall graphics for the Avira Udaan exhibition.
storyTitle: A busy event, given one visual rhythm.
story: The campaign balances practical information with a festive market illustration. Repeated colours and framing connect guest posts, invitations, sponsorship graphics and individual stall posters.

title: Posters made to stop the scroll.
alt: Coffee poster with dimensional typography and a flying coffee splash
description: A selected collection of campaign, announcement and promotional posters across different voices and audiences.
storyTitle: A different voice for every message.
story: From retail and recruitment to public announcements and cultural moments, each poster begins with the message and builds a visual world around it.

title: A little coastal, a lot personal.
alt: Ananya and Chirag’s coastal wedding stationery, featuring a custom AC monogram, palms and seashells
description: A coastal-inspired wedding identity and stationery suite for Ananya and Chirag, with a custom monogram and details drawn from the shore.
storyTitle: Their story. A seaside state of mind.
story: Soft coastal colours, seashells, palms, and a personal monogram bring the couple’s beach wedding vision into one visual world. The project connects invitations and welcome-kit details through a shared design language.

notes: The monogram, palms and shells set one visual language that can carry across the full celebration.

title: Stories you can hold.
alt: Desira’s brochure design combining editorial typography, photography and structured page layouts
description: Brochure design by Desira, pairing photography, clear typography and considered layouts to make information easy to explore.
storyTitle: A considered layout, cover to cover.
story: Print gives a story its own rhythm. This brochure brings photographs, written content, and visual hierarchy together in a format that invites readers to explore the details.

title: Prerna & Rishabh: a celebration illustrated.
alt: Illustrated wedding invitation cover for Prerna and Rishabh
description: A twelve-page invitation world for Prerna and Rishabh, with illustrated venues, ceremony scenes and a changing palette for every celebration.
story: Each event receives its own illustrated setting while floral details, architectural references and a shared typographic rhythm keep the suite connected.

notes: The opening turns the venue into the first piece of the couple's illustrated world.
Every ceremony gets a distinct scene, so guests can recognise the mood before reading the details.
Dates, times and venues stay clear while illustration carries the personality around them.
The palette changes with each event, held together by recurring florals, architecture and fine-line details.

title: Tradition, with a personal touch.
alt: A custom invitation by Desira combining floral illustration, traditional motifs and a soft pink palette
description: A custom invitation that brings traditional motifs, floral detail, and a personal visual language together for a meaningful celebration.
storyTitle: Rooted in tradition. Made for today.
story: Cultural detail and a modern composition meet in this invitation project. The result brings the feeling of the occasion into the design through illustration, colour, and careful attention to the brief.

notes: Floral illustration and traditional motifs frame the information without letting ornament overpower it.
